scorecard.title: Shipping / refund policy verification
scorecard.recommendation: This store's robots.txt disallows /policies/*, so a compliant scanner — and any AI shopping agent or price-comparison tool that honours robots.txt — can't verify your shipping/refund terms programmatically. Consider allowing those two specific paths if you want that trust signal visible to automated buyers.
scorecard.evidence: robots.txt disallows /policies/* (and /*/policies/*) for User-agent: *, so the shipping/refund policy pages were not fetched (shipping policy not checked (robots.txt disallows); refund policy not checked (robots.txt disallows)); linkedFromHome=false

limits: scores are indices, not currency: public storefront data carries no order-volume or revenue signal

A3: a sold-out variant on a merchandised product is intent lost; we cannot see how much
